svg.text: From pixels to a sequence: the patch embedding
a strided convolution does the cropping, flattening and projection in one go
raster order: left to right, top to bottom
A patch is just a token. Everything downstream — attention, MLP, residuals, normalisation — is exactly the
Transformer encoder from the previous chapter, with 256 patch tokens where words used to be.
The position embedding is learned, not sinusoidal, and there are exactly 256 of them — one per grid slot. That is
why a ViT trained at 224 x 224 cannot simply be handed a 448 x 448 image: the patch count changes and the
position table no longer lines up. PaliGemma ships a separate checkpoint per resolution for exactly this reason.
